_doc: The product's short list of live figures to re-check after each deploy: each figure people act on, where the live product shows it, and a second way to compute it from the product's own data. After a deploy the figure is read from liveAddress at readAt and compared with secondWayQuery's answer; a gap larger than tolerance is a wrong number on the live site. Every field is required; check the file with: node scripts/quality/live-figures-check.mjs .quality/live-figures.json (templates/quality/README.md).
